Release notes


# Weekly Dispatch: April 14, 2025


April 14, 2025


‍ **⚙️ Dispatch**


- Dispatch strategies can be configured to auto-dispatch based on relative time to pickup
- Automations can be run after an order updates
- New webhook event for unassigned orders after optimization
- Create optimization automations for orders using specific tags.
- Automation available for events relative to drop-off time


‍


**🕹️ Control**


- The dispatch activity list now includes optimization strategy names for greater clarity.
- Open your favorites in a new tab from the sidebar
- Email order ingestion now displays actual email received
- POD view now includes the signatory_name field
- Actions taken by AI agents are now visible in the delivery timeline


‍


**📱 Engage**


- Shopify: Email Pickup order details directly to staff members
- Delivery tracking available in Shopify native emails


‍


**🖥️ Platform**


- Zip code-level analytics now available for providers
- Provider performance metrics now include delivery distance insights
- User roles now include a dedicated Billing Administrator role


‍


**🤖 AI**


- AI agents can send proof of delivery (POD) via SMS
- Trigger notifications can now support voice agents as a desitination


‍


**🛒 Promise**


- Blackout dates are now customizable in Shopify widget


‍


**🚚 Fleet**


- Optimization now limits vehicle selection to those with shift availability


‍
